entities.name: SCG Failure Reporting Procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to report Secondary Cell Group failures when neither MCG nor SCG transmission is suspended and specific failure conditions are met.

entities.name: SCGFailureInformationNR
entities.description: Message transmitted by UE to report SCG failures when in (NG)EN-DC mode.

entities.name: SCGFailureInformation
entities.description: Message transmitted by UE to report SCG failures.

entities.name: T304
entities.description: Timer for SCG that is stopped upon SCG failure reporting initiation.

entities.name: Neither MCG nor SCG transmission suspended
entities.description: Precondition for initiating SCG failure reporting procedure.

entities.name: Radio link failure for SCG
entities.description: Condition triggering SCG failure reporting when radio link failure is detected for SCG.

entities.name: Beam failure of PSCell while SCG deactivated
entities.description: Condition triggering SCG failure reporting when beam failure occurs on PSCell while SCG is deactivated.

entities.name: Reconfiguration with sync failure of SCG
entities.description: Condition triggering SCG failure reporting when reconfiguration with synchronization fails for SCG.

entities.name: SCG configuration failure
entities.description: Condition triggering SCG failure reporting when SCG configuration fails.

entities.name: Integrity check failure indication from SCG lower layers
entities.description: Condition triggering SCG failure reporting when integrity check failure is indicated from SCG lower layers concerning SRB3.

entities.name: Suspend SCG transmission
entities.description: Action to suspend SCG transmission for all SRBs, DRBs, and BH RLC channels when procedure is not initiated due to beam failure.

entities.name: Reset SCG MAC
entities.description: Action to reset SCG MAC when procedure is not initiated due to beam failure.

entities.name: Stop conditional reconfiguration evaluation for CPC
entities.description: Action to stop conditional reconfiguration evaluation for CPC if configured.

entities.name: (NG)EN-DC state
entities.description: UE operating mode where UE initiates transmission of SCGFailureInformationNR or SCGFailureInformation messages.

relations.description: SCG failure reporting procedure requires that neither MCG nor SCG transmission is suspended.
Procedure initiation is guarded by radio link failure for SCG condition.
Procedure initiation is guarded by beam failure of PSCell while SCG deactivated condition.
Procedure initiation is guarded by reconfiguration with sync failure of SCG condition.
Procedure initiation is guarded by SCG configuration failure condition.
Procedure initiation is guarded by integrity check failure indication from SCG lower layers condition.
Procedure includes step to suspend SCG transmission when not initiated due to beam failure.
Procedure includes step to reset SCG MAC when not initiated due to beam failure.
Procedure stops T304 timer for SCG if running.
Procedure includes step to stop conditional reconfiguration evaluation for CPC if configured.
Procedure includes step to initiate transmission of SCGFailureInformationNR message when in (NG)EN-DC.
Procedure includes step to initiate transmission of SCGFailureInformation message when in (NG)EN-DC.
Procedure requires UE to be in (NG)EN-DC state for message transmission steps.
Beam failure condition guards whether SCG transmission suspension step is executed.
Beam failure condition guards whether SCG MAC reset step is executed.
